coordinates: px = [x, y] in pixels on `image` above, y increasing downward. ll = [latitude, longitude]. The two are related by the human alignment in mr053-071-alignment.json; px is the useful one for comparing against the scan.
what: Every modern street whose geometry falls inside this document's coverage polygon, as it runs TODAY. These are the corridors the document has to be read against. `crossings` are the intersections usable as `from`/`to` in a row.
